disclaimer_summary: Cases built with gtopt's own conversion tools, verified only as far as the authors can, NOT validated by the publishing institutions; provided AS IS without warranty; never to be used as a reference for analysing official operation scheduling or for financial analysis.
description: Machine-readable index of the gtopt case collection (INPUTS ONLY: source data, gtopt case inputs and how to run them; no results). One entry per case. Paths are relative to the repo root (case_json relative to the case path); run commands assume REPO=<this checkout>.

collections.countries: Cases of real power systems, by country: <country>/<application>/<case>; data published by system operators, regulators and research groups.
collections.benchmarks: Standard test systems, example systems of other tools and published case studies: benchmarks/<family>/<case> (papers: benchmarks/papers/<author_year_topic>/<case>); 'family' names the group; 'country' is null. Open-licence sources are kept in source/; sources without a licence are recipes (source.redistributed false) built by tools/get_case.py fetch.

revisions_note: converter.gtopt_revision, converter.converter_last_change and size.lp.gtopt_revision record the gtopt development revision used for the conversion or the LP-size check (pre-publication history; may not exist in the public repository https://github.com/gtopt-community/gtopt). To rebuild a case, use the named converter from gtopt master of November 2026 or later.

daily_scheduling.flavor: cen-trad0: PLEXOS/CEN-faithful (--plexos-legacy --no-battery-efin-pin), traditional piecewise losses with loss_cost_eps=0

tsf1.note: tangent_signed_flow losses with loss_cost_eps=1.0 (current converter default); documented, not built

medium_long_term.note: plus any plp2gtopt flags passed with tools/get_case.py plp --plp2gtopt-arg; boundary cuts are emitted by plp2gtopt as system.future_cost_array (boundary_cuts.csv)
